target_customer: Enterprises and mid-size firms in logistics, legal, healthcare, banking and similar sectors with manual back office data entry and filing workflows
problem: Traditional RPA bots are brittle and expensive to build and maintain. Sola records a process once and uses LLMs and vision to create bots that adapt when systems change.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for an automation platform with enterprise contracts

founders.name: Jessica Wu
founders.background_notes: YC page also says she worked at med-tech, fashion and crypto startups on design and engineering.

founders.name: Neil Deshmukh
founders.background_notes: YC page says research on computer vision and LLMs and ML work at startups in several fields. Founders have been friends since freshman year at MIT.

competitors.name: UiPath
competitors.what: Incumbent RPA platform adding generative AI assistant (Autopilot) for text to workflow
competitors.traction_then: Public RPA leader; Autopilot announced at its Forward conference

technical_complexity.rationale: Turning screen recordings into self healing bots with vision and LLMs needed reliable perception of arbitrary desktop and browser UIs in 2023, which was early and hard for a five person team.

defensibility.rationale: Core models are widely available and incumbents plus agent startups pursued the same wedge. Deployed bots and integrations give some lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: UiPath announced a generative AI Autopilot in October 2023. Sola was not acquired and raised a Series A in August 2025.

market_need_then: RPA was an established multi billion dollar category with known maintenance pain, and generative AI in 2023 opened a chance to rebuild it. Demand evidence is mainly that incumbents were adding AI.

branding.domain_note: Moved from sola-solutions.com to sola.ai, which now redirects (observed 2026).

identity.visual_style: Enterprise SaaS site with customer logos and compliance badges
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and forward looking, 'A new era of process automation'

rebrands.why: Domain move only; the legal name Sola Solutions Inc. remains. Reason not stated.

branding.community_and_virality: No evidence found; searches on the brand returned unrelated companies named Sola.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with many unrelated firms; no press on the brand itself.

pivots.to: AI native agentic process automation platform
pivots.why: Not stated; positioning changed in 2025 materials

outcome_analysis: Sola entered a large RPA market just as LLMs made bots cheaper to build, raised a 3.5 million seed led by Conviction and a 17.5 million Series A led by a16z in August 2025. Enterprise customers in legal and logistics are named on its site. Risk remains from UiPath and agent startups, but no shutdown or exit was found.
notes: Seed date is given as 2023 only because the company page does not state it. Series A headline says 17M while body says 17.5M; 17.5M used since it matches the stated 21M total. Series A date taken from coverage dated 2025-08-14. UiPath source is dated 2023-10, shortly after the batch, so it is the nearest dated evidence. Name origin not found.
